Title: Opts the state out of certain provisions of the Depository Institutions Deregulation and Monetary Control Act of 1980, Public Law 96-221
Summary: Opts the state out of certain provisions of the Depository Institutions Deregulation and Monetary Control Act of 1980, Public Law 96-221; establishes applicable interest limitations.
LawCode: Amd §14-a, Bank L; add Art 11 §§1101 - 1104, Fin Serv L
ActClause: AN ACT to amend the banking law and the financial services law, in relation to opting the state out of certain provisions of the Depository Institutions Deregulation and Monetary Control Act of 1980, Public Law 96-221
